upstash-redis-js-root.description: Work with the Upstash Redis JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for serverless Redis operations. Use for caching, session storage, rate limiting, leaderboards, full-text search (querying, filtering, aggregating with @upstash/redis search extension), and all Redis data structures. Supports automatic serialization/deserialization of JavaScript types. Search also available via @upstash/search-redis and @upstash/search-ioredis adapters for TCP clients.
